payload.title: File:Parastylephorus anatoides (life restoration).png
payload.credit_html: "A new fossil from the Eocene of Iran provides new insights regarding the evolution of the morphologically bizarre tube-eye fish"
payload.description_html: Artistic reconstruction of Parastylephorus anatoides. Note that the tubular eyes are based on the condition characteristic of the extant Stylephorus chordatus. Artwork by Lucrezia Bonardo.
